description: Figure 8 illustrates the relationship between sample size and the number of shared Top-6 routed experts, averaged across model layers, for two independent samples. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10⁶, with tick labels at intervals of 10⁰, 10¹ , 10² , 10³ , 10⁴ , 10⁵, and 10⁶. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Top-6 routed experts” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0.  There are two lines displayed: a blue solid line representing the first sample and a red dashed line representing the second sample. The blue line begins at approximately 2.2 when the sample token count is 10⁰ and increases to approximately 5.6 when the sample token count is 10⁶. The red line begins at approximately 2.4 when the sample token count is 10⁰ and increases to approximately 5.8 when the sample token count is 10⁶.
